Between 8 and 9:15 in the morning, the ★ stocks\' overnight news in one notification, and during the day (7 am to 10 pm) a notification as soon as a big announcement like results, an order or a dividend comes
The ★ stocks\' morning news and big announcements

Each stock\'s detail has its own \"News\" tab: NSE\'s announcements of the last 30 days (BSE\'s for a stock listed only on BSE) and the last week\'s newspaper stories (from Google News, in English and Hindi), newest first. At least 10 items show: for a stock with little news, announcements and stories go back up to 1 year. A dot on the tab means fresh news. Each item names its kind (results, order, dividend, expansion, legal…), and \"Pre-market\" (came after the last close; the next session opens on it) or \"Live\" (came during today\'s market). Tap to open the full story or the announcement\'s PDF. 📰 on the list means the stock had an exchange announcement in the last 24 hours; tapping it opens the stock straight on the \"News\" tab, as the news notifications do. With \"Watchlist news\" on in Menu → Scan, the ★ stocks\' morning news and the day\'s big announcements come as notifications. The app doesn\'t say whether news is good or bad — read it and decide yourself.
